Phase 1 — Component CustomEvents (3 files, 80 lines changed)
  - ThemeToggle.astro: extended theme-changed CustomEvent dispatch to include detail: { from: current, to: next }. Backward-compatible — Nav.astro listener does not read detail.
  - Gallery.astro: added fire() helper; openLightbox fires analytics:gallery_image_open after lightbox is shown; closeLightbox now accepts method param and fires analytics:gallery_lightbox_close before hiding; added navigate(direction, via) helper; updated lbPrev/lbNext, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keydown, touchend swipe to call navigate() instead of showImage() directly; updated closeLightbox callers to pass method.
  - PricingContactForm.astro: added fire() helper; delegated open handler fires analytics:pricing_form_open after dlg.showModal(); closeBtn fires analytics:pricing_form_close method=close_button; backdrop branch fires analytics:pricing_form_close method=backdrop; validation now tracks failedFieldNames[] and fires analytics:pricing_form_validation_error with fields joined; fires analytics:pricing_form_submit_attempt right after disabling submit; fires analytics:pricing_form_submit_success after addDoc success; fires analytics:pricing_form_submit_error in catch.

Phase 2 — analytics.ts new blocks (123 lines added)
  - Block 14: consent_granted ping fired once at top of setupTracking() after page_metadata.
  - Block 15: cookie_manage_open for #manage-cookies and #manage-cookies-bottom.
  - Block 16: mobile_menu_toggle for #hamburger-btn using requestAnimationFrame to read aria-expanded after Nav handler runs.
  - Block 17: theme_change listener on document for theme-changed CustomEvent reading detail.from/detail.to.
  - Block 18: contact_float_click for #contact-float FAB; also extended existing whatsapp_click block 5 to assign location=floating_widget when link.id === contact-float.
  - Block 19: outbound_click for all a[target=_blank] not already covered by whatsapp/email/social/partner handlers — covers blog link in Nav and Footer.
  - Block 20: hero_scroll_indicator_click for .scroll-indicator.
  - Block 21: CustomEvent forwarder for all six analytics:pricing_form_* events.
  - Block 22: CustomEvent forwarder for all three analytics:gallery_* events.

  - analytics.ts included at BaseLayout.astro:398 — covers all locale pages automatically.
